content.comment_body: Hello, I am working on a project using [product_name] V8.1.1. I've transferred my project to the PLC and would like to perform an online test. The software prompts for a Windows operation to send data to the PLC and receive data from the PLC to the computer, but when I do this, I can only see the project without any texts or supporting annotations. What could be the issue?
If you download a program from the [product_name], you will only get the program code itself. The device does not store texts or comments.

The problem seems to be with the graphical arrangement. Input and output names aren’t displayed, and their organization appears random. Why is it not possible to use online monitoring for my project while other projects allow online testing?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble conducting online monitoring with [product_name] V8.1.1. Upon retrieving a project from the PLC, all label information and explanatory texts are missing, resulting in only the raw code being visible. This makes it difficult to distinguish inputs and outputs and causes the graphical display to seem unorganized, which complicates understanding and monitoring compared to other projects where online testing works smoothly.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to view their complete project—including all texts, input/output labels, and a clearly organized graphical layout—while using online monitoring in [product_name], similar to the experience found in other projects where online tests work as expected.
